1. **Screenshot 1 (the catch):** a texting conversation with "Emily" — his line *"I'll never see a face like yours in years of girls to come"* (sent 1:25PM), her delighted reply *"Hehe stopp you're so sweet Ty handsome?!"* (1:55PM).
